paragraphs.text: Following the unification of Argive and Korlis into the Combined Kingdoms , Urza was appointed as the kingdoms' Lord High Protector. As part of the same ceremony, Tawnos was appointed Master Scholar.

The ceremony was extremely formal and long-winded and involved numerous people, from plenty of Argivian nobles , Korlisian merchants, Yotian representatives, and even dwarves from Sardia and the Brotherhood of Gix .
The ceremonies were attended by Kayla bin-Kroog and her seven-year-old son Harbin , as well as schoolmaster Richlau and senior students Sanwell and Rendall .

During his coronation, Urza received an elaborate miter , which Tawnos thought Urza was strangely pleased to wear. Urza later showed Tawnos that the miter was an artifact lined with numerous small powerstones .
After the Liberation of Yotia , Yotia was added to the Combined Kingdoms as a vassal state.
